verdict.rationale: Riveter exposes a documented REST API (endpoints like /enrich, /runs/{id}, /datasets, webhook_url, dry_run, max_credits) plus official SDKs (Go client shown) with auth, retries, pagination and polling — clearly a documented, programmatic interface an AI-native user could drive directly. Missing for 10: a machine-readable spec (OpenAPI/swagger and llms.txt both returned 404 in probes) and independent third-party confirmation of the API's completeness/stability.
